title: 2027 memory capacity is reportedly sold out
summary: Major memory manufacturers including Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron have reportedly sold out their HBM (High Bandwidth Memory) production capacity through 2027 due to unprecedented AI and GPU demand, continuing the industry-wide 'RAMageddon' supply crunch that began in 2024.
problem_solved: The article reports on the ongoing semiconductor memory supply shortage rather than solving a problem.
why_valuable: Understanding this memory supply constraint helps businesses and developers plan long-term AI infrastructure investments and hardware procurement strategies.
